name: dusk-dev
description: The dusk development plugin: the working agreements as hooks, the workflows as skills, a race inspection and a code review as agents.

interface.shortDescription: The dusk repository's working agreements and the workflow that ships a change in it.
interface.longDescription: Load dusk-developer for the orientation map and the working agreements every change in the dusk repository is held to, activate for what there is to know about the repository before a change, and drive-issue for taking a GitHub issue to a merged pull request. atomic-commit, splice, what, honest-to-god, authoring-a-program and adding-a-driver-method cover the rest of the work.
defaultPrompt: Read the dusk-developer skill and tell me what the working agreements say about comments.
